# Find Your Kind of Credit Card

With Northwind Visa credit cards, you have options that fit the way you spend.

### Everyday Visa

- No annual fee.
- Variable Annual Percentage Rate (APR) of 13.50%–20.50%1.

### Travel Visa

- Earn 2 points for every $1 spent on travel.
- Variable Annual Percentage Rate (APR) of 17.50%1.

## Frequently Asked Questions

- Can I add my Northwind cards to a mobile wallet?

Yes. You can add your Northwind debit and credit cards to Orchard Pay, Meadow Pay or Summit Pay and set one as your default.
